featured_reviews.name: Pratik Gadgil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Simplicity should convince

Would a simple white-walled structure with no frills convince you to visit a dear sweet shop in a world where even the smallest of the establishments try to get in some style or decor, if not vibrance, to attract customers? Well, they say they don't judge a book by its cover, and this shop says they don't make hunches without seeing the product. Generally, a sweet shop does have some farsan / namkeen items and a repertoire of sweets; this one has only selected categories of sweets. Is that a niche? I am somewhere in between for that. Add to that the bygone and nasty phrase, "We only accept cash" ( more on that, later ); it must feel hard to see it in today's world.

On my two visits here, I bought the following items:

1. Kala Kand Pista & Strawberry flavour -  Very sweet, albeit not dulcified, but most importantly, felt like a coloured filling of sugar assembled under the tag of kala kand; I have eaten far better Kala Kands before and at relatively lower prices.

2. Kaju Katli - superb. Some like it hard, some like it soft. The pieces were big -- probably the biggest I have had; coated with silver, reasonably sweet and medium hard.

3. Walnut Halwa - The best of the lot!  A rich walnut flavour dessert sprinkled with pieces of almonds, reasonably sweet in taste but one could feel the taste of real walnuts. Very authentic!

At Rs 1,600 a kg, it is at least 20% higher than the average market rate, but if you are undecided and open to all options, the first one you should go for is the Walnut Halwa.

4. Mawa roll - a richly textured roll containing dry fruits and made in ghee. It was delicious, but do keep in mind that it might not be for everyone's appetite.

The staff was very friendly and one doesn't often see the staff giving an entire piece of Kaju Katli just to taste. I still dared to ask them for online payment; they said, yes. So, I suppose, for purchases over a certain amount, GPay/PhonePe is accepted.

featured_reviews.review_text:
As one enters the shop everything looks very clean and organised. The staff is well trained in informing about their history, exchanging pleasantries and manages to put up a smile but what actually matters is their Mithais that they are selling which are not fresh!!!

This was the first time I bought an Ice Halwa, varieties of Pedas (white & brown) and some khakharas. They don't provide any sample tasting of their Mithais. Later upon the manager's intervention I was given a small sample of their brown peda which was fresh but not the other white peda or the Ice Halwa... I found that odd but went ahead on the trust of their rich legacy which was told to me by their staff... This was the first red flag.

Even though the staff knew that the sweets have gone stale they still sold it to me.  Upon tasting, I found out the truth about their stale mithai and also found out that they had not provided me with an invoice :-( Second red flag.

Now as I join the dots and it all makes sense that they probably have got good at clearing their stale products off the shelf and making money...
This was not experience that I had hoped for...

name: Brijwasi Sweets, Original Since 1946 - GD Group - Nana Chowk
description:
In the early forties, a young man from Braj in Mathura, landed on the shores of the bustling metropolis called Mumbai. He arrived with a dream to have his own shop selling traditional mithais from his beloved Braj Bhoomi. While he established his first outlet in Kalbadevi, little did he know that he was in fact pioneering a leading chain of stores which would one day become a household name! This was our patriarch Ramswarup ji...

Subsequently, his son Bankelalji, and his succeeding present generations, have grown from strength to strength from that first outlet to several others across the city today. We continue to follow the age old traditional recipes to bring you the finest flavours in our products.

Truly impressive quality. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

Parina Mehta Shah

featured_reviews.review_text:
This is is the new outlet of Faredoons at Tardeo.
Mostly a takeaway  joint as it has no seating.
You can stand & eat on the side.
Ambiance  is good with nice display of items available.
They have different rolls,buns,pastries, coffee  & Bombay Soda.
Had their OG mayo chicken roll,chicken ghee roast bun,chocolate pastry & rasberry Bombay Soda.
Everything was good & value for money.
Worth a visit when in Tardeo area.

The hamper was with a plantable rakhi made with cotton and seeds attached to it.

Thanking Harshita for taking the hassle of getting it delivered late at night, really appreciate it.

featured_reviews.name: Afsana Mubaraki
featured_reviews.review_text: Products of Ovenly Bakery are  a must try if you are looking for decadent, delicious desserts. My daughter has a sweet tooth and when she tried the products that I got from Ovenly Bakery, she had a big smile on her face and said she was in Dessert Heaven. I got a big thank you hug from her post her indulgence. It's definitely on our list of favourite go to places.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your heartwarming feedback 💜 we hope to continually serve you with the best and be there for your celebrations !

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Paisawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Harshita at Ovenly Bakery exceeded all expectations. Her warm, friendly service was outstanding, accommodating a last-minute sugar-free chocolate cake request. This cake was a marvel, impeccably balanced, neither too sweet nor too bitter. The quality and taste of the chocolate were exceptional, conveying a rich, satisfying flavor. Harshita made my dad's birthday special, transforming a same-day request into a delightful memory. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a truly delightful cake experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank You for such a wonderful feedback, Mohammed. It was a pleasure to bring you that joy through our food. Your words of praise are so well articulated it deserves a token of appreciation. I wish you remember Ovenly for more celebrations. We look forward to brighten your day and be a part of such moments again . 
Ovenly Yours- Chef Harshita
